name: general-mcp
description: Bundles user-wide MCP servers for Excalidraw, Playwright, Azure DevOps/ADO, Azure (azmcp), MongoDB (read-only), and Meta Ads (read-only tools). Local servers launch via npx; ADO and Azure reuse your Azure CLI sign-in, MongoDB and Meta Ads read credentials from environment variables, and Excalidraw and Meta Ads use remote HTTP.
